intent: Implement bounded diagnostic capture, persistent critical evidence, independent resumable stages, honest export validation and memory telemetry; remedy source defects behind the supplied partial GitHub verification report without weakening operation authorization or evidence requirements.

work_packages.scope: Bounded persistent critical ring and streaming stable log snapshots with explicit empty/disabled states
Single export admission, staged checkpoints, resource limits, reduced-memory retry, manifest verification and memory diagnostics
Paged conversation/tool data, independent research/profile stages and actionable partial-export UI
Graph/read/CI failure recovery, exact resource evidence and bounded continuation/checklist completion
Behavior regression tests, host checks and current-revision Android CI

acceptance.export: An empty or failed stage cannot be reported as complete; available redacted critical evidence is packaged first and retained across failed or cancelled stages.
acceptance.memory: No export-time whole-history hydration; fixed buffers, bounded records and section limits with measured memory metadata.
acceptance.privacy: Preserve diagnostic opt-in, temporary-chat isolation and credential redaction.
acceptance.github: A listed endpoint or accepted dispatch is not a passed integration capability or test execution; preserve exact revision, run/job receipts and fixture ownership.
acceptance.qualification: Device/vendor/LAN observations remain unverified without actual execution in those environments.

disk_logs.qualification: Production bounded queue, ring, snapshot, formatting, coalescing and privacy helpers; application-boundary doubles where required.

github_focused.qualification: Production sources with explicit Android/network boundary doubles

affected_device.scope: Actual ASUS device low-memory capture and underlying original failures

bounded_source_readers.qualification: Stored-value, protected-workspace and research-page production implementations; database source separately compiled against explicit Android/SQLite boundaries.

export_integration.qualification: Five production adapter scenarios with explicit Android/source doubles, plus four frozen-log behavior regressions. Actual Robolectric integration tests await Android CI.

journal_snapshot_bounds.qualification: Actual journal source compiled; focused snapshot byte/event-cap behavior exercised with storage boundaries.
